facts: Public name: Carlos Alfredo Carpio Meza.
Public role wording: Engineer · Inventor · Creative Technologist.
Location is intentionally not public.
Short biography: Engineer, inventor, and creative technologist exploring AI, electronics, resilient energy, music, astrology, and numerology through practical systems and experimental interfaces.

Long biography: Carlos works across artificial intelligence, electronics, resilient energy, music, astrology, and numerology. His portfolio connects engineering practice with creative experimentation, presenting verified work separately from prototypes, personal studies, and future concepts.

records.title: The Observatory
facts: The Observatory is the public homepage frame of this portfolio, not a separate product.
Enter the Observatory is a public navigation action on the homepage.
The Observatory homepage is a visual first room. Public apps live on Work, Cosmos, Arcade, and Sound; they are not scientific products.

records.title: StrudelAI
facts: StrudelAI is a public live-coding music system.
The public test build is https://strudelzeroai.app.canner.ca/.
The public repository is https://github.com/uset82/StrudelAI.
The build is ready for testing, and people interested in contributing are welcome.

records.title: ASTROEA and Pináculo
facts: Carlos built two public apps for astrology and numerology, framed as creative and personal practice, not scientific, medical, or predictive advice.
ASTROEA is a public astrology repository at https://github.com/uset82/ASTROEA. Its README describes natal-chart work inspired by astro.com. A live demo is at https://astraia.netlify.app/.
Pináculo is a public numerology repository at https://github.com/uset82/pinaculo. A live demo is at https://pinaculo.netlify.app/. Interpretations draw on Carl Jung.
The portfolio Cosmos page at /cosmos points to these apps. It does not host them, collect birth data, or publish Carlos's private travel stories, charts, or dates.
The repositories are public to read. They do not carry an MIT licence on this site's contribution list.
